10–25

WHEN
Now. Level 10–25 fits you, so you can quest here while you gather.
Skinning skill-ups from Deviate Scale, Medium Leather and Medium Hide until about 130 (you're at 120).
Quiet: most players have moved past this zone, so nodes stay up. Any time works.
Sell what you gather at Tue 7 PM (Medium Leather +12% vs now).

Kalimdor, your faction's territory.
Skin Thunderheads, Stormhides, Hecklefang Stalkers and Zhevra Coursers (about level 20–23) around Field of Giants, Blackthorn Ridge and Camp Taurajo for Medium and Heavy Leather. Good skill-ups for you.

3 node types still give skill-ups.
